symptoms: Irregularly irregular pulse, palpitations, lightheadedness, dyspnoea
ECG: Absence of P waves, irregular QRS complexes

management_steps.action: Stable AF - Rate Control (Goal HR < 110 bpm)
management_steps.details: Amiodarone: 150mg IVI in D5W over 30min, then 900mg in 200ml D5W at 8.3mls/hr. Beta-blockers (Carvedilol 3.125mg PO, Atenolol 50mg PO, Propranolol). Calcium Channel Blockers. Digoxin.
Calculate CHA2DS2-VASc and HAS-BLED scores for anticoagulation decisions.

warnings: AF with Wolff-Parkinson-White (WPW) syndrome: AVOID rate controlling agents (Beta-blockers, CCBs, Amiodarone, Digoxin) — perform electrical cardioversion only.
